_what: The client's design tokens: every colour, size, gradient, material, typeface and timing a screen draws with, read by ui/tokens.gd into Palette, UI and the kit (ui/rb_*.gd). No screen names a value of its own. Each value cites the section of the design document it comes from, or the Screens v3 source and use count it was measured from (docs/analysis/screens-v3/design-system.md), or says it is the client's. v3.7's 21.8 adopted the designs' typefaces and surfaces, so the design's values are the values here.

material._what: What a panel or control is made of, drawn by ui/rb_box.gdshader in one quad: fill (a gradient), line (ink outline: colour, points), rim and rim_2 (inner rims), highlight (a lit band inside the top edge), shade (a dark band inside the bottom), drop (a hard drop: colour, points down), soft (a soft shadow: colour, points down, blur points), glow (colour, points), gloss (a soft white lacquer over the top half, 0 to 1), the colours its words take (text, text_2) and text_bg, the stops its words sit on, which the contrast checks read. Points are the client's.
